title: Health Snapshot (HealthKit Reading)
description: One point-in-time HealthKit reading posted by the iOS app. All metrics are optional (null) — the client sends what's available. Validated server-side against clinical sanity ranges. testerId is a project-local id, never a name or account.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601. Client timestamp when the snapshot was captured.

testerId.description: Random project-local tester id. Never a name or account identifier. Null if not provided.

heartRateBpm.description: Current heart rate in beats per minute. Null if unavailable.

restingHeartRateBpm.description: Resting heart rate in bpm. Null if unavailable.

hrvMs.description: Heart rate variability in milliseconds. Null if unavailable.

stepsToday.description: Step count today. Null if unavailable.

activeCaloriesToday.description: Active calories burned today (kcal). Null if unavailable.

exerciseMinutesToday.description: Exercise minutes today. Null if unavailable.

exerciseGoalMinutes.description: Daily exercise goal in minutes. Null if unavailable.

standHoursToday.description: Stand hours today (Apple Watch stand ring). Null if unavailable.

standGoalHours.description: Daily stand goal in hours. Null if unavailable.

recentWorkouts.description: Recent workouts from HealthKit. Empty array if none.
